pages.text: Shovel uses the same trait pool as Pickaxe for mining, including $(l:traits/crushing_traits)Crushing$() and $(l:traits/ancient_traits)Ancient$().$(br2)$(#55FFFF)Broad Touch I$() (2 slots) — $(item)Slime Ball$() — 3×3 dig.$(br2)$(#55FFFF)Broad Touch II$() (4 slots) — 1×1 / 3×3 / 5×5 modes.$(br2)See $(l:traits/pickaxe_traits)Pickaxe Traits$() for full bind items and values.$(br2)$(#FF5555)Not allowed:$() Poison, Freezy, Sharpy, Titan, Ranger.
